newsitem.title: ITALY: Duce's last residence to be luxury Italian hotel.
newsitem.headline: Duce's last residence to be luxury Italian hotel.

text.p: The last residence of Italian fascist dictator Benito Mussolini, a villa near Lake Garda, is to be turned into a luxury hotel, the town's mayor said on Wednesday.

The 19th century Villa Feltrinelli di Gargano del Garda, where Mussolini lived when he headed a Nazi puppet regime in northern Italy at the end of World War Two, will become a 25-room hotel, mayor Daniele Roscia said.
The property, which had belonged to the Italian publishing family Feltrinelli, was bought in 1981 by a businessman from the northern town of Brescia.
Mussolini and his mistress Claretta Petacci were shot dead on April 28, 1945 and their bodies strung up in a central Milan square.
